narrative.overview:
Aether WebOS Kit v2.1 turns unstructured plain-English notes into Wave 0 to Wave 2 floorplans through meteorite cleavage and hairline editorial clarity. Built by Eloquent (@mjeanhudson-dev), the page opens on a Warm Alabaster vs. Obsidian split anchored by a macro geological meteorite cutout, pans a six-plate 25-turn amnesia autopsy, drops into basalt-and-obsidian mirror-void silence, awakens a single-pass Sobel PBR WebGL image-relighting Peak over three macro mineral plates, and closes in a lazy-hydrated borderless Operate studio and 472px colophon.

Hierarchy uses 1px hairlines, tonal obsidian steps, 2px control corners, self-hosted BricolageGrotesque and RedHatMono WOFF2 fonts, and Molten Troilite Amber reserved for primary actions and active landmarks.
keyCharacteristics: Split Warm Alabaster (#F2EFE8) vs. Obsidian (#07090D) polarity paired with scoped [data-aw-surface="obsidian"|"paper"] Operate surfaces.
Zero box-shadow, zero backdrop-filter, zero [data-sc-progress] spoiler bars, and zero rounded card grids.

Single-pass Sobel PBR WebGL image-relighting Peak (./webgl/artifact-shader.js, MAX_DPR = 1.25, per-plate aspect correction, staggered uploads, static paused redraws, 3-plate CSS cross-fade fallback) paused offscreen (IntersectionObserver, visibilitychange, contentvisibilityautostatechange) with Pause shader (WCAG 2.2.2, no aria-pressed).
Self-hosted WOFF2 fonts (./fonts/*.woff2, 103.0 KB total) and 7 macro geological WebP plates with ./assets/*.webp.json provenance sidecars, zero external requests.

rules.name: The Cleaved Polarity Rule
rules.body: Pair Warm Alabaster (#F2EFE8, #111214) directly against Obsidian (#07090D, #ECEAE4, #A8B0BC) along 1px seams rather than blending mid-grays.

rules.name: The Molten Troilite Reserve Rule
rules.body: Restrict #E27A2C strictly to primary actions, active landmarks, and mineral glints; pair solid fills with #111214 ink and shift inline amber text to #EA8D44 (obsidian) or #984306 (paper).

rules.name: The Scoped Dual-Surface Rule
rules.body: Confine [data-aw-surface="obsidian"|"paper"] toggling to #aether-webos-mount so narrative acts hold fixed lighting.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Self-Hosted Rule
rules.body: Serve only self-hosted BricolageGrotesque (preloaded) and RedHatMono WOFF2 fonts from ./fonts/ with font-synthesis-weight: none; never add third-party font stylesheets or unnecessary above-fold preload stalls.

rules.name: The Monospace Measurement Rule
rules.body: Reserve RedHatMono (tabular-nums) for digests, day indices, coordinates, and Markdown/capsule text editors rather than decorative prose.

rules.name: The Surprise-Over-Spoiler Rule
rules.body: Omit [data-sc-progress] top bars so horizontal travel, Mirror Void silence, and Peak cleavage land without progress spoilers.

rules.name: The Budgeted Single-Peak Rule
rules.body: Permit one active WebGL context (./webgl/artifact-shader.js) capped at 1.25 DPR with staggered texture uploads, static paused redraws, and 3-plate CSS fallback, pausing requestAnimationFrame offscreen, when hidden, or under content-visibility: auto, paired with Pause shader (WCAG 2.2.2).

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Never add drop shadows or blurred glass; convey elevation exclusively via stepped tonal fills and 1px hairline partitions.

rules.name: The Sharp Control and Mineral Edge Rule
rules.body: Keep containers at 0px and controls at 2px; render mineral silhouettes as real RGBA alpha mattes with provenance sidecars rather than CSS clip-path masks.

rules.name: The Borderless Operate Hairline Rule
rules.body: Partition #act-studio and #act-curriculum with 1px hairlines, surface steps, and 2px active strokes rather than rounded, shadowed SaaS cards.

dos: Do pair #E27A2C fills strictly with #111214 ink, and shift inline amber text to #EA8D44 (obsidian) or #984306 (paper) for >= 4.5:1 AA contrast.
Do keep Paper/Obsidian toggling scoped to #aether-webos-mount via [data-aw-surface="obsidian"|"paper"].
Do retain content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size and explicit width/height on WebP assets to hold CLS 0.00.
Do wire Pause shader (WCAG 2.2.2), prefers-reduced-motion static fallbacks, and offscreen/hidden rAF pausing on WebGL stages.
Do avoid em dashes (U+2014 or HTML mdash entity) across copy and docs, and cite only ./ or ~/ paths under Eloquent (@mjeanhudson-dev).
donts: Don't add [data-sc-progress] bars, 01 / 06 section counters, backdrop-filter blur, box-shadow glows, or border-radius above 2px.
Don't add kickers or eyebrows above headings, synthetic weights outside 400/700, or remote font CDN links.
Don't run multiple WebGL contexts or leave requestAnimationFrame active offscreen or under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Don't mask mineral cutouts with CSS clip-path geometry instead of true RGBA alpha mattes.
Don't edit ./scrollcraft.js or ./scrollcraft.css, leak local OS usernames, or fabricate user quotes or metrics.
